title: Enum Privacy and Trait Scope
goal: Understand enum visibility rules and trait method resolution.

sections.text: Unlike structs, public enums expose all their variants and fields automatically.

sections.caption: Both `Active` and `Inactive` are public because `Status` is public.

sections.text: You cannot make an individual enum variant private. Enums are all-or-nothing.

sections.caption: Traits must be imported into scope before calling their methods.

sections.text: If a trait is not in scope, Rust will not find its methods on a type even if the type implements the trait.

explanation: Understand enum visibility rules and trait method resolution.
